f3.en: Six reasons families and caregivers across New Zealand and Australia choose to work with Joyful.
f3.zh: 这六大优势，是新西兰与澳大利亚各地家庭和护理人员选择 Joyful 馨悦月嫂服务中心的原因。

f5.en: Every caregiver completes our structured training program — led by nursing experts from top-tier Taiwan confinement centres and informed by traditional Chinese medicine, including confinement meal (月子餐) preparation — and holds relevant certification before placement.
f5.zh: 每位护理人员上岗前均完成由台湾顶级月子中心护理专家打造、融合中医背景的系统培训（含月子餐制作），并持有相关资质认证。

f7.en: Before service begins, we help clarify each carer's readiness, transport expectations, service scope, and payment or tax handling so the arrangement feels clear and reliable.
f7.zh: 服务开始前，我们会协助确认护理人员的服务准备、交通安排、服务范围，以及付款和税务处理方式，让整个安排更清楚、更安心。

f9.en: Our coordination team supports English and Chinese communication, with LINE, WeChat and WhatsApp contact options for different families.
f9.zh: 我们的协调团队提供中英双语沟通支持，并可通过 LINE、微信 WeChat 与 WhatsApp 等方式服务不同家庭。

f11.en: We take time to understand each family's needs, coordinate communication through the matching process, and continue following up after service begins so both the family and caregiver feel supported.
f11.zh: 我们会先深入了解每个家庭的需求，再进行合适匹配，并在过程中协助双方沟通协调；服务开始后也持续跟进，让家庭与护理人员双方都有支持。

f13.en: We support families in cities and towns across New Zealand and Australia, including arrangements within NZ and between NZ and Australia.
f13.zh: 我们服务新西兰与澳大利亚各城市及城镇的家庭，也支持新西兰本地不同地区之间，以及新西兰与澳大利亚之间的服务安排。

f15.en: Live-in or live-out, day or overnight shifts, short-term or extended stays — we tailor the arrangement to your family.
f15.zh: 住家或非住家、白班或夜班、短期或长期，我们为您灵活安排服务形式。
